title: Refresh React-phase vitals/emotion/relationship/memory snapshots post-action and fix stale turn-prompts.ts examples

sections.what: Recompute vitalsNL, emotionNL, relationshipNL, and read-only memoryNL from freshPlayer/freshState before buildResultReactionPrompt executes, and align turn-prompts.ts lines 239/241 examples with the canonical emotion contract.
sections.why: In static/js/agent-engine.ts (lines 1692-1712), after an action mutates the world and `await worldState.fetch()` retrieves `freshPlayer` and `freshRoom`, line 1712 still feeds the stale pre-action `vitalsNL`, `emotionNL`, `relationshipNL`, and `memoryNL` computed at turn start (lines 1442-1445) into `buildResultReactionPrompt`. Additionally, static/js/agent/prompt-builder/turn-prompts.ts mixes `emotion_toward` (line 237) with legacy `"emotion":null` in the silent/noop JSON examples (lines 239, 241).
sections.how:
1. In static/js/agent-engine.ts around lines 1692-1713, rebuild `vitalsNL`, `emotionNL`, and `relationshipNL` from `freshPlayer` and `freshState` after `await worldState.fetch()`, and refresh `memoryNL` read-only (`{ preview: true, area: freshPlayer?.current_area }`) when the character moved or the room/stimulus changed.
2. Update static/js/agent/prompt-builder/turn-prompts.ts lines 236-242 so silent and noop examples use the canonical emotion field shape matching line 237 and StructuredFormats.agentReact (`bug-596`).
3. Add JS unit coverage verifying post-action state deltas propagate into result-reaction prompts.
sections.verify: 1. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs verifying post-action vitals/emotion/location updates reach buildResultReactionPrompt instead of pre-action turn-start snapshots, and turn-prompts.ts has zero inconsistent legacy `"emotion":null` examples.

acceptance.text: Result-reaction prompts pass refreshed vitalsNL, emotionNL, relationshipNL, and memoryNL derived from freshPlayer/freshState after worldState.fetch() rather than stale pre-action turn-start strings.

static/js/agent/prompt-builder/turn-prompts.ts replaces legacy hardcoded `"emotion":null` examples (lines 239, 241) with the canonical emotion contract aligned with line 237 and StructuredFormats.agentReact.
JS unit tests verify post-action vitals/emotion/location changes appear inside buildResultReactionPrompt during a multi-phase turn.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal Raw LLM trace and Prompt Preview for the result-reaction phase (`agent-engine.ts` -> `buildResultReactionPrompt`).

Current availability: agent-engine.ts line 1712 passes turn-start vitalsNL, emotionNL, relationshipNL, and memoryNL from lines 1442-1445 into buildResultReactionPrompt even after fetching freshPlayer/freshRoom post-action; turn-prompts.ts lines 239 and 241 still emit legacy `"emotion":null` examples.

Manual verification steps:
1. Trigger an action that changes vitals, location, or emotions (e.g. eat food, take damage, move room) in reactive mode.
2. Inspect the result-reaction prompt sent to the LLM in Agent Lens / Raw LLM capture.
   - expected: React prompt shows post-action vitals, updated emotions/relationships, and refreshed memory context (via preview:true or current room cues) alongside consistent JSON examples.
